MAJOR OIL SPILL SPREADS OFF UAE COAST AMID IRAN WAR Satellite images show an expanding oil spill off the UAE coast, threatening beaches and marine ecosystems. Authorities have closed coastal areas in Umm Al Quwain, Sharjah and Ras Al Khaimah as containment efforts continue. Experts link the spill to a tanker reportedly struck by a projectile last month, though the cause remains unconfirmed.

RED SEA SHIPPING RECOVERS, BUT COSTS REMAIN HIGH Bank of America reports Red Sea shipping traffic has recovered to 65% of normal levels, up from 50% in September. However, oil tanker rates remain elevated at up to $650,000 per day, while dry bulk rates are up 31% year-over-year. The key takeaway: Shipping is recovering, but high freight costs continue to threaten global inflation. Source: Bank of America Research

NETANYAHU FACES ELECTION SETBACK AS ISRAELI EXIT POLLS SHOW DEADLOCK Israeli exit polls show Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu’s bloc running neck and neck with opposition leader Gadi Eisenkot, with neither side projected to secure the 61 seats needed for a parliamentary majority. Voter turnout reached 77.7%, the highest in more than two decades. Arab parties could hold the balance of power, although coalition negotiations remain complicated.

US IRAN WAR COSTS SURPASS $47 BILLION, PENTAGON ESTIMATES The US military has spent more than $47 billion on the war in Iran, according to Pentagon data reviewed by Reuters, exceeding the Defense Department’s July estimate by over 25%. The costs include more than $29 billion to replenish munitions and over $6 billion to replace military equipment. The estimate does not clearly account for repairs to US bases damaged by Iranian missile and drone attacks.

OPENAI REPORTEDLY PLANS TO BUY GOOGLE AI CHIPS OpenAI plans to purchase AI chips from Google ($GOOGL), according to The Information, citing a person familiar with the matter. Financial terms and the size of the potential deal were not disclosed. Reuters has not independently verified the report.
